Name: Monster Clumps
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[i]Monsterlike rock clumps have appeared in the mines, offering you their treasure, if you're lucky and strong enough to break them.[/i][/center][center][/center]
[center][b]Possible Drops:[/b]
Dust Clump: [i]Ores & Coal[/i]
Dwarf Clump: [i]Artifacts[/i]
Fire Clumps: [i]Wood & Coal[/i]
Junimo:[i] Gems[/i]
Shadow: [i]Void- & Solaressence[/i]
Skeleton:[i] Bonefragments & Bone Artifacts[/i]
Slime: [i]Slime & Slimeggs[/i]


[b]Things to note:[/b]
[i]There is a chance to not receive anything from the clumps, since none of their resources has a droprate over 50%[/i]


[b]Requirements[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6669]Custom Resource Clumps[/url][/center]
